note: USD per million tokens, Anthropic first-party API rates (claude-api reference, cached 2026-06-24). The workflow runtime reports one token count per agent with no input/output split, so cost_est_usd prices each model's tokens at a blended rate: blend.input * input_rate + blend.output * output_rate. Agentic runs are dominated by re-read context, so the default blend is 90% input / 10% output; cache reads (~0.1x input) are ignored, which makes the estimate conservative on the high side for cached prefixes. Edit blend or rates here; the ledger recomputes on `ledger recost`.
